{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mists of Forgetfulness''' was a location in a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]], which was reached by separating one's mind from their body, a technique which was mastered by the [[Mind Walkers]] at [[Sinkhole Station]]. it appeared as a misty area at the far end of the [[Lake of Apparitions]]. When traveling beyond shadows with the Mind Walkers in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], saw a [[Abeloth|strange being]] who beckoned them. However, when the spirit of [[Darth Caedus]] told them that they had plenty of time to get to her, they realized that they had anything but time, and returned to their bodies in Sinkhole Station where they were [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] by a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]].
